facts.value: FY2025 net sales $20.074B, +19.9% reported and +15.8% organic; GAAP net income attributable to BSX common stockholders $2.898B; adjusted diluted EPS $3.06.
FY2025 OCF $4.534B, capex/internal-use software $0.876B, SBC $0.299B and D&A $1.368B.
H1 2026 sales $10.646B, +9.5% reported/+8.1% organic; Q2 sales $5.442B, +7.5% reported/+7.0% organic. H1 adjusted EPS $1.66.
H1 2026 OCF $1.822B was essentially flat YoY despite sales growth; capex/internal-use software $0.372B and SBC $0.170B.
Q2 2026 gross margin was about 70.7% versus 67.7% prior year; mix, tariff recovery and lower inventory charges contributed.
FARAPULSE became the predominant component of Electrophysiology revenue after rapid PFA adoption; WATCHMAN is the global leader in percutaneous LAAC.

By Q2 2026 management acknowledged softer Watchman demand and greater U.S. electrophysiology competition; specialist reporting says PFA share declined while PFA already represented roughly 80-85% of U.S. ablation procedures.
Pending Penumbra transaction has about $15B equity value, approximately $11B cash and $4B BSX stock, with about 41M BSX shares fixed at signing; FTC issued a Second Request in March 2026.
BSX paid $1.6B including a prior $0.1B payment for a MiRus equity interest and TAVR option, with a further $3.0B option exercise price after milestones.
BSX used $2.0B for an accelerated share repurchase in H1 2026; July 30 shares outstanding were 1.449B.

The Aug. 25 cyber incident disrupted manufacturing, order processing and shipping. By Sep. 9 manufacturing, order fulfillment and shipping were fully restored, but the company expects a material Q3/FY2026 impact and withdrew confidence in prior guidance.
EY issued an unqualified FY2025 financial-statement opinion and found ICFR effective in all material respects.

estimates.value: Standalone normalized TTM owner cash $3.2B-$3.6B, central $3.4B. Mechanical OCF-capex is $3.625B; SBC remains an economic cost.
First-full-year post-Penumbra normalized owner cash central estimate $3.3B on about 1.490B shares, reflecting transaction dilution/financing drag before full synergy realization.

inferences.value: Boston Scientific remains a high-quality procedure-growth compounder, but 2024-25 PFA hypergrowth is normalizing and competitive share pressure is now visible.
At current price valuation risk has fallen materially; the dominant underwriting risk has shifted to whether Penumbra and MiRus earn attractive incremental returns after financing and integration.
